checks.description: Overview current status, next steps and truthful availability
Updates hierarchy, reviewed manual flow and meaningful policy/storage consequences
System current versus next-boot mode and no unintended restart
Software prerequisites, structured reviews and unknown-operation recovery
Identity public trust, SSH and private backup distinguished; truthful review/stale status
Mainsail current versus selected login method, certificate guidance and secret-safe cancellation
Recovery capability limits and safe preparation links without invented procedures
Definitions search/group/drill-down with counts, recovery and no mutation
Source preview/management consequences and retained selection/error context
Connections filter/results/inspector semantics with documented versus unknown contacts
Cross-route ordinary reads, elevated writes, drafts, keyboard/cancellation and supported reflow
